# Spec: Sign in with Keycloak

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/sign-in.md)

**Start:** `/identity/me`  
**Persona:** A user opening the example for the first time  
**Goal:** Sign in through the identity provider and land on the screen that was asked for.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Get sent to the identity provider | The Keycloak sign-in form is shown. |
| 2 | Enter your credentials | You return to the screen you asked for.<br>The header shows your user name. |
| 3 | Read your claims | The preferred user name claim is listed. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `sign-in`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
